overview: You read the Rose bill at the lodging. The title was The Wise Man, at two. There was no sum on the paper. You did not cross. Your own afternoon was the Theatre.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the title and did not cross.

assets.name: The Wise Man
assets.disposition: Read The Wise Man and went to the Theatre
